plugin.name: hide-pointer
plugin._long: Hides the pointer while you type or once it has rested, until the mouse is used again. Loaded only when [input] hide_pointer_when_typing or hide_pointer_after_seconds is set.

option.name: when_typing
option._long: Hides the pointer when a key that types a character is pressed.

option.name: after_seconds
option._long: Hides the pointer once the mouse has rested this many seconds; 0 never does.
